steps.message: a structure must stand at least the parcel's setback from the lot line
a structure must stand at least the parcel's setback from the lot line

notes: The setback, inherited from the locality through parcel-a, is 50 ft = 2 tiles of 25 ft. Hoop house at 1,8: clearance 1 tile = 25 ft < 50, refused. At 2,8: clearance min(2, 3) = 2 tiles = 50 ft >= 50, accepted (the bound is inclusive). Commons 2x2 at 10,10 covers column 11: 12 - 11 = 1 tile = 25 ft, refused. At 9,10 it covers columns 9-10 and rows 10-11: min(9, 12 - 10, 10, 25 - 11) = 2 tiles = 50 ft, accepted. Counts are tiles: hoop 2, commons 4; areas 2 x 625 = 1250 and 4 x 625 = 2500; labour 1 house x 75.5.
